question.problem:
Solve the system of equations represented by the augmented matrix 

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 2 & -1 \\ 0 & 1 & 3 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 3\end{aligned}].
$$
question.worked_solution:
The matrix represents a system of three linear equations in three variables, say, $x$, $y$, and $z.$ We obtain the following system of linear equations:

$$
{\begin{aligned} & x+y+2z=-1 \\  & y+3z=2 \\  & z=3\end{aligned}
$$

The third equation states that $z=3.$ Substituting this into the second equation, we get

$$
y+3(3)=2\,⟹\,y=2-9=-7.
$$

Now, we substitute $z=3$ and $y=-7$ into the first equation to get

$$
x+(-7)+2(3)=-1\,⟹\,x=-1+7-6=0.
$$

Therefore, the solution is $x=0$, $y=-7$, and $z=3.$ In vector form, the solution can be written as $⟨0,-7,3⟩.$
